loadedTools.name: browser_create
loadedTools.description: Create one temporary or named persistent Browser Profile, Browser Workspace, browser instance, and tab.

profile.description: temporary discards identity; persistent restores a named Profile.

name.description: Named persistent Browser Profile. Required when profile is persistent.

attach.description: Attach a new instance or tab to an existing Session-owned hierarchy.

kind.description: workspace starts another instance; browser starts another tab.

browserId.description: Existing browser instance to reuse when kind is browser.

loadedTools.name: browser_focus
loadedTools.description: Focus one browser tab using its latest revision.

expectedRevision.description: Latest revision returned by a browser operation.

loadedTools.name: browser_screenshot
loadedTools.description: Capture the deterministic PNG screenshot facts for one browser tab.

loadedTools.name: browser_navigate
loadedTools.description: Navigate one browser tab to a URL using its latest revision.

expectedRevision.description: Latest revision returned by a browser operation.

url.description: URL to open in the browser tab.

loadedTools.name: browser_observe
loadedTools.description: Observe the latest facts for one browser tab, including a closed receipt.

loadedTools.name: browser_input
loadedTools.description: Record one human pointer or keyboard mutation on a browser tab using its latest revision.

expectedRevision.description: Latest revision returned by a browser operation.

url.description: Optional URL produced by the human mutation.

text.description: Optional page text produced by the human mutation.

loadedTools.name: browser_close
loadedTools.description: Close one browser tab using the latest revision. Temporary Profiles discard identity; named Profiles keep the persist partition.

expectedRevision.description: Latest revision returned by a browser operation.

loadedTools.name: browser_takeover
loadedTools.description: Record reported human ownership of one browser tab using its latest revision. The lock is the revision; a later Agent mutation that observes the current revision may reclaim the tab.

expectedRevision.description: Latest revision returned by a browser operation.

loadedTools.name: browser_return_control
loadedTools.description: Record reported Agent ownership of one browser tab using its latest revision. The lock is the revision; this does not add a second lock.

expectedRevision.description: Latest revision returned by a browser operation.
